(يضرّ) an imperfect verb, nominative [Note: This i'rab is the best we can adopt in such an expression, when the imperfect comes in the nominative while being the apodosis - and it is the view of al-Mubarrad - because this fāʾ may occur in other places, as in His saying, the Exalted: فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلا يَخافُ بَخْساً وَلا رَهَقاً [al-Jinn - 13]. As for Sībawayh, he makes it nominative because it is an indication of the apodosis, with the intention of fronting.], and the fāʾ is implied, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (كيد) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, accusative (manṣūb), i.e. anything of harm. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the ism (subject) of إنّ, accusative. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to محيط. (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (محيط) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «تمسسكم حسنة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تسؤهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تصبكم سيّئة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يفرحوا بها» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تصبروا.
The clause «لا يضرّكم كيدهم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, with the fāʾ implied [Note: What permitted making the clause in the position of the jussive, rather than in the position of the nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) as is customary, is that the clause is preceded by the negative particle (لا); this is close to the verb being preceded by the negatives (لن) or (ما) when the clause is joined with the fāʾ.].
The clause «إنّ الله ... محيط» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(كيد) an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb كاد يكيد, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(محيط), a noun from the quadriliteral أحاط; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and the weak letter was made vowelless because of heaviness. In the word there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change): its origin is محوط, with sukūn on the ḥāʾ and kasra on the wāw. The kasra on the wāw was felt heavy, so its vowel was transferred to the ḥāʾ, and it became محوط with kasra on the ḥāʾ and sukūn on the wāw; then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because of the kasra before it, and it became (محيط) (see al-Baqara - 19).

* Rhetoric:
1- The expression here with "touching" (al-mass) for the good and with "striking" (al-iṣāba) for the evil is merely for variety of expression, by way of the implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya). This is of the marvellous speech before which necks are cut short [i.e. which none can match].

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted, «لا يَضُرُّكُمْ» is jussive as the apodosis. The rule for the doubled verb when it is made jussive is that its vowel has three options: the first, that it is given a vowel matching the vowel of the verb's ʿayn; the second, that it takes the fatḥa because of the lightness of the fatḥa; and there is a third reading of the verb «يضركم» with kasra on the ḍād and the sukūn appearing on the end of the verb. This reading is according to «undoing the assimilation of the doubled verb when it is made jussive».

safi-cedvel:121-121.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember). (غدوت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, (التاء) the fāʿil (agent), (من أهل), a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (غدوت), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (تبوّئ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (المؤمنين) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) [Note: or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, which is the lām; it has occurred in His saying, the Exalted: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنا لِإِبْراهِيمَ مَكانَ الْبَيْتِ.]. (مقاعد) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (للقتال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبوّئ) [Note: or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مقاعد.], (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (سميع) khabar (predicate), nominative. (عليم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «غدوت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تبوّئ ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of غدوت [Note: It is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), because the times of setting out and of stationing differ; it may be concomitant, i.e. intending to station the believers in positions.].
The clause «الله سميع» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مقاعد), plural of مقعد, which is a noun of place from قعد يقعد, of the class of نصر; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, because the ʿayn in the imperfect has ḍamma.

* Benefits:
1- There are some verbs that can come as defective, putting the ism (subject) in the nominative and the khabar in the accusative, and can come as complete, being content with their fāʿil. Among them is the verb «غد» [Translator's note: thus in the source, for غدا], which can be used in the meaning of going in the morning, so it is a complete verb. It may come in the meaning of صار (became), as in your saying «لقد غدا فلان صديقا» (So-and-so has become a friend), «so فلان is its ism and صديقا its khabar».

safi-cedvel:122-122.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of the إذ occurring in the previous verse [Note: or it is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم in the previous verse.], (همّت) a past verb ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (طائفتان) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the alif. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (طائفتان), (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تفشلا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and (الألف) is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفشلا) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, which is the bāʾ, and the preposition is attached to (همّت).
(الواو) resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (وليّ) khabar (predicate), nominative, and (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّل) [Note: The preposition was fronted here to give it importance.], (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition [Note: The implied form is: إن فشل بعض الناس فليتوكّل المؤمنون على الله (if some people lose heart, then let the believers rely on Allah).].
(اللام) the lām of command. (يتوكّل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (المؤمنون) fāʿil, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «همّت طائفتان» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تفشلا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «الله وليّهما» has no grammatical position, resumptive - or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) -.
The clause «يتوكّل المؤمنون» is the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: The implied form is: إن فشل بعض الناس فليتوكّل المؤمنون على الله.], and the implied conditional clause is conjoined to the clause الله وليّهما.

safi-cedvel:123-123.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (نصر) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (ببدر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نصركم), and the bāʾ means "in" [Note: The preposition may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of نصر, i.e.: He helped you while you were present at Badr.]. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أذلّة) khabar (predicate), nominative. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the ism (subject) of لعلّ. (تشكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «نصركم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer of an implied oath.
The clause «أنتم أذلّة» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: i.e.: if Allah did that for you, then fear Him.].
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(أذلّة), plural of ذليل, an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from ذلّ يذلّ, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعيل. It has two other plurals: أذلّاء and ذلال with kasra on the dhāl.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَأَنْتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ» the speech is a kināya (metonymy) for the smallness of their number and equipment and the weakness of their condition. That is because they went out on water-camels, several of them taking turns on a single camel, and they had with them only one horse.

safi-cedvel:159-159.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (رحمة) genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لنت); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة; (لنت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil (agent); (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (لنت); (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a non-jussivizing conditional particle; (كنت) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn,
and (التاء) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (فظّا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (غليظ) a second khabar, accusative; (القلب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (انفضّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (من حول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انفضّوا), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لنت..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كنت..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لنت.
The clause «انفضّوا» has no grammatical position, occurring as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (اعف) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (عنهم) like لهم, attached to (اعف); (الواو) conjunction; (استغفر لهم) like اعف عنهم; (الواو) conjunction; (شاور) like اعف, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في الأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شاورهم); (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis, in the position of accusative; (عزمت) like لنت; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (توكّل) like اعف; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكّل); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna; (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is "he" (هو); (المتوكّلين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «اعف عنهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if they do wrong, then pardon them.
The clause «استغفر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اعف.
The clause «شاورهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اعف.
The clause «عزمت» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis are conjoined to the implied condition.
The clause «توكّل ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «إنّ الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يحبّ المتوكّلين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(لنت): it involves a phonetic change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) to suit the indeclinability on the sukūn; its original form is لينت: two sukūns came together - the sukūn of the yāʾ and the sukūn of the nūn - so the yāʾ was dropped. Its pattern is فلت with a kasra on the fāʾ, the kasra being an indication of the dropped letter.
(فظّا): a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from فظّ يفظّ, of the fataḥa class (bāb fataḥa); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn.
(غليظ): a resembling adjective from غلظ يغلظ, of the naṣara class, the ḍaraba class and the karuma class.
(المتوكّلين): plural of المتوكّل, an active participle from the five-letter verb توكّل; it is on the pattern متفعّل, with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- «ما» is not a complete indefinite noun meaning "thing", as some grammarians held, nor is it interrogative conveying wonder, as al-Fakhr al-Rāzī suggested. Nor is its being redundant in the Noble Qur'an a detraction from the eloquence of the Qur'an and from the freedom of Allah's speech from idle words; for the addition of a particle in Arabic is not arbitrary, but has purposes and benefits, some of which are too subtle to conceive and some of which need no explanation. «ما» in this verse is redundant in terms of i'rab, but it is not redundant or empty of meaning: it conveys emphasis and makes the meaning clearer and more firmly established. Moreover, we would not depart from the truth if we added that it provides rhythmic cadence and verbal resonance in the composition of the Noble Qur'an, which pairs its verbal inimitability with its semantic inimitability equally.
Ibn al-Athīr has a view on the redundancy of «ما»: he denies that it is redundant with no meaning, and holds rather that it came to magnify the blessing that Allah bestowed on His Messenger and poured upon him, so that on account of it he was gentle with the people.
Dropping it would diminish the meaning and weaken the structure. He brands whoever claims that there is redundancy in the Noble Qur'an without benefit as one of two men: either ignorant of the eloquence of the Arabs, or deviating from the highway of religion.
We are pleased that Ibn al-Athīr echoes what we have said about the redundancy of «ما» in this verse, for he says:
«What the grammarians say about (ما) in this verse, that it is redundant, they mean only that it does not prevent what precedes it from governing; do you not see that it did not prevent the bāʾ from governing the genitive in الرحمة?» So consider well.

safi-cedvel:160-160.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (ينصر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (غالب) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (الواو) conjunction; (يخذلكم) like ينصركم; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from ذا; (ينصر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينصر), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّل), the preposition phrase being fronted for its importance; (الفاء) linking an implied apodosis; (اللام) the lām of command; (يتوكّل) an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, and given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; (المؤمنون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «ينصركم الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا غالب لكم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «يخذلكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «من ذا الذي ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «ينصركم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «ليتوكّل المؤمنون» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the believers want victory, let them rely on Allah ... and the implied conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(غالب): an active participle from غلب يغلب, of the ḍaraba class (bāb ḍaraba); its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(هنا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, departing from its literal spatial sense, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (دعا), which is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif. (زكريّا): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif. (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ربّ): a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative; the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the omitted (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (هب): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (هب). (من): preposition. (لدن): a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to (هب) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ذرّيّة.]», and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (ذريّة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (طيّبة): naʿt (adjective) of ذريّة, accusative like it. (انّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) is the noun of إنّ. (سميع): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative. (الدعاء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «دعا زكريّا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قال.» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «the vocative.. رب» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, for imploring mercy.
The clause «هب لي» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنك سميع» لدعاء has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(دعا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is دعو: the wāw came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif. It is of the نصر class.
(هب): it contains iʿlāl by deletion. Its past is وهب, a weak verb of the mithāl type (first radical weak), whose fāʾ is deleted in the imperfect and imperative; its pattern is على with fatḥa on the ʿayn «[Translator's note: so in the text; the pattern intended is evidently عل.]» (and see verse 8 of this sūra).
(سميع): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) — one of the attributes of Allah — or an intensive form of the active participle, because it is from the transitive سمع يسمع, of the فرح class; its pattern is فعيل (see verse 127 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(الدعاء): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution) of the lām of the word, which is the wāw, into hamza, because it came at the end after a quiescent augment alif; its origin is الدعا وفهو «[Translator's note: so in the text, evidently a misprint for "الدعاو، فهو".]» from the verb دعا يدعو; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ (see verse 171 of Sūrat al-Baqara).

safi-cedvel:161-161.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (كان) a deficient past verb; (لنبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna, fronted; (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative; (يغلّ) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يغلّ) is in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna, postponed.
(الواو) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يغلل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is "he"; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (يأت); (غلّ) a past verb, indeclinable ... and its fāʿil is "he"; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb يأت; (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (توفّي) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (كلّ) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كسبت) a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "she" (هي); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (لا) negative; (يظلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, in the passive ... and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «ما كان لنبيّ..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يغلّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «من يغلل» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يغلل» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]».
The clause «يأت ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussivizing condition not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «غلّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «توفّى كلّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يغلل «[Note: It is permissible for (ثمّ) to be resumptive - as will come in Sūrat al-ʿAnkabūt - and in that case the clause is resumptive.]».
The clause «كسبت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هم لا يظلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا يظلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Rhetoric:
1- Intensification in the prohibition in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما كانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ»; what is meant is to clear the Prophet ﷺ in the most eloquent way of what the archers suspected of him on the day of Uḥud.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): conjunction. (نادت): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif, which was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.. (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الملائكة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (قائم): khabar (predicate), nominative. (يصلّي): imperfect verb, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (في المحراب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصلّي) or to the active participle قائم. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (يبشّر): imperfect verb, nominative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (بيحيى): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبشّر), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "with the birth of يحيى".
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله يبشّرك) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (نادته), i.e. "the angels called him that Allah gives you glad tidings".
(مصدّقا): ḥāl, accusative, from يحيى. (بكلمة): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle (مصدّقا) «[Note: The Word: meaning ʿĪsā, peace be upon him, i.e. confirming ʿĪsā; Yaḥyā was the first to believe in him.]». (من الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. (الواو): conjunction. (سيّدا): conjoined to (مصدّقا), accusative like it; and likewise (حصورا، نبيّا), conjoined by two conjunctions, accusative. (من الصالحين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (نبيّا); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نادته الملائكة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «هو قائم..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, either from the object pronoun in نادته or from الملائكة.
The clause «يصلّي في المحراب» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو.
The clause «يبشّرك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.

* Morphology:
(نادته): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the alif, which is converted from a yāʾ, was deleted from it because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is فاعته.
(قائم): active participle from قام يقوم; the weak letter, the wāw, was converted into hamza regularly in the active participle of the hollow verb, where the weak letter is always converted into hamza after the alif of فاعل (see verse 18 of this sūra).
(يحيى): there are two views about it. The first: that it is transferred from the imperfect يحيا, because the Arabs often name with verbs, such as يعيش and يعمر; some said they named him يحيى because Allah gave him life through faith.. On this view it is a diptote because of being a proper name and having the pattern of a verb. The second view: that it is foreign with no derivation — and this is the apparent view — so its being a diptote is due to being a proper name and foreign.
(كلمة): a noun for what a person utters, single or compound; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then kasra, and it may be read on the pattern فعلة with kasra then sukūn (see verse 37 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(سيّدا): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from ساد يسود on the pattern فيعل; its origin is سيود: the yāʾ and the wāw met in the word with the first quiescent, so the wāw was converted into yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ.
(حصورا): a derived adjective; it is an intensive form of the active participle; its pattern is فعول with the meaning of فاعل. The حصور is one who does not approach women while being capable of that.

safi-cedvel:162-162.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation «[Note: Meaning negation, in the view of Abū Ḥayyān.]»; (الفاء) resumptive; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتّبع) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (رضوان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الكاف) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (باء) a past verb, and its fāʿil is "he"; (بسخط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (باء) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of باء, i.e. bound up with wrath.]»; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سخط; (الواو) conjunction; (مأوى) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنّم) khabar, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (المصير) fāʿil, nominative. The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it" (هي), i.e. Hell.
The clause «من اتّبع رضوان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «باء بسخط» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «مأواه جهنّم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause باء بسخط.
The clause «بئس المصير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(السخط): the maṣdar (verbal noun) of سخط يسخط, of the fariḥa class (bāb fariḥa); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (38) of this sūra.]». (أنّى): an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); or an adverb meaning "from where", attached to (mutaʿalliq) the complete (يكون), or to its khabar if it is incomplete. (يكون): a complete imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكون) «[Note: Or to the omitted khabar of يكون if it is incomplete.]». (غلام): the fāʿil (agent) of يكون, nominative «[Note: Or the noun of the incomplete يكون, with (لي) its khabar.]». (الواو): of the ḥāl. (قد): particle of realisation. (بلغ): past verb; (النون) is the nūn of protection and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الكبر): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (امرأة): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (عاقر): khabar (predicate), nominative. (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (كذا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is يفعل «[Note: Or attached to an omitted khabar, with the mubtadaʾ implied, i.e. "the matter is thus".]»; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يفعل): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو", i.e. Allah.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) «[Note: Or the vocative clause alone is a parenthetical supplication with no grammatical position, and the clause أنّى يكون is the object of the saying.]».
The clause «أنّى يكون لي غلام» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «بلغني الكبر» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «امرأتي عاقر» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الله يفعل..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «يفعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(عاقر): active participle from عقرت تعقر, of the ضرب and كرم classes; its pattern is فاعل, and it has the meaning of the passive, i.e. المعقورة (the barren).
(غلام): a primitive (jāmid) noun of entity; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:163-163.t:
* I'rab:
(هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative; (درجات) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "possessors of degrees" (ذوو درجات); (عند) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of درجات; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بصير) khabar, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to بصير «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to بصير.]»; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «هم درجات» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله بصير ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative.

* Rhetoric:
1- «هُمْ دَرَجاتٌ»: He likened them to steps in their varying in height and lowness, by way of istiʿāra (metaphor); or He made them the very degrees, to intensify the variation, so it is an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh) with the particle of comparison omitted.

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (37) of this sūra.]» «[Translator's note: the parsing of قال ربّ is in fact given at verse 38.]». (اجعل): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (آية): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو". (آية): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أن): maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (لا): negating. (تكلّم): imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الناس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تكلّم الناس) is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ آيتك.
(ثلاثة): adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تكلّم). (أيّام): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إلّا): particle of exception. (رمزا): excepted, accusative by the disconnected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-munqaṭiʿ) — gesture is not speech — or the connected one — gesture being a kind of speech. (الواو): conjunction. (اذكر): imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت". (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (كثيرا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, as it is its adjective. (الواو): conjunction. (سبّح): like اذكر. (بالعشيّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سبّح). (الواو): conjunction. (الإبكار): conjoined to العشيّ, genitive like it.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ربّ اجعل (the vocative one)» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اجعل» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «آيتك ألا تكلّم الناس» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «اذكر» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the second clause of the object of the saying.
The clause «سبّح» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the second clause of the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(رمزا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رمز يرمز, of the ضرب class and the فتح class; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(العشيّ): a singular, or a plural whose singular is عشيّة. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is عشيو — because its verb is عشا يعشو, maṣdar عشو. When the yāʾ and the wāw met at the end of the word with the first quiescent, the wāw was converted into yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ, so it became عشيّ.. Its pattern is فعيل.
(الإبكار): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أبكر; its pattern is إفعال.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying, the Exalted, «رمزا» there is the art of ishāra (gesture/allusion), because it indicated the stirrings and meanings within the human soul.

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted, «إِلَّا رَمْزاً»: in this word there is an indication of the art of gesture and suggestion by means of posture and movement. Our poets in times past alluded to this direction. Abū Tammām said!
توحي بأسرارنا حواجبنا ... وأعين بالوصال ترتشق
(Our eyebrows convey our secrets, and eyes that exchange glances of union.)
And he also said:
كلّمته يجفون غير ناطقة ... فكان من رده ما قال حاجبه
(I spoke to him with eyelids that do not speak, and his reply was what his eyebrow said.) «[Translator's note: يجفون is printed so; بجفون "with eyelids" is evidently intended.]»
And another said:
إذا كلمتني بالعيون الفواتر ... رددت عليها بالدموع البوادر
(When she spoke to me with languid eyes, I answered her with hastening tears.)
It is worth mentioning that some authors among the scholars of the West have taken this path and written books on the art of gesture and its role in expression, which have their value and popularity.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إذ): an adverb in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". (قال): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (الملائكة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (يا): vocative particle. (مريم): a vocative of a single proper name (munādā mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (الله): the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (اصطفى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (الكاف) is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الواو): conjunction in both places. (طهّرك): like اصطفاك, and likewise the second اصطفاك. (على نساء): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اصطفاك). (العالمين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قالت الملائكة..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّ الله اصطفاك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «اصطفاك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «طهرك» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اصطفاك.
The clause «اصطفاك» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اصطفاك (the first).

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(يا مريم): its i'rab has been given in the previous verse. (اقنتي): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (لربّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اقنتي), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction in both places. (اسجدي، اركعي): like اقنتي. (مع): adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to the verb اركعي. (الراكعين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اقنتي لربّك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «اسجدي» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اقنتي.
The clause «اركعي» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اقنتي.

* Rhetoric:
1- «يا مَرْيَمُ»: the repetition of the vocative is to announce that what is intended by the address is what comes after it, and that the reminder of blessings before it was a preparation for mentioning it and an encouragement to act according to it.
2- «وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ», fronting (taqdīm): prostration was placed before bowing, either because that was the order in their sacred law, or because prostration is the most excellent pillar of the prayer and the utmost degree of submission.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الكاف) is a particle of address and (اللام) is for distance. (من أنباء): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (الغيب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (نوحي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of accusative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty. (إلى): preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نوحيه). (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating. (كنت): an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (التاء) is the noun of kāna. (لدي): adverb of place, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted khabar of kāna, and (هم) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (إذ): an adverb for past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted khabar. (يلقون): imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أقلام): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أيّ): an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (يكفل): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (مريم): mafʿūl bihi, accusative; it is prevented from tanwīn because of being a proper name and feminine. (الواو): conjunction. (ما كنت لديهم إذ): like the first. (يختصمون): like يلقون.
The clause «ذلك من أنباء الغيب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «نوحيه» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الغيب.
The clause «ما كنت لديهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يلقون..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أيّهم يكفل..» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb.
The clause «يكفل..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أيّهم.
The clause «ما كنت لديهم (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first.
The clause «يختصمون» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

* Morphology:
(أنباء): plural of نبأ, which is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from أنبأ or نبّأ; the regular maṣdar of the two verbs would be إنباء — with kasra on the first hamza — or تنبئ. The pattern of نبأ is فعل with two fatḥas.
(يلقون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, following the same course as تلفوا «[Translator's note: so in the text; تلقوا is evidently intended.]» (see verse 195 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(أقلامهم): plural of قلم, a primitive (jāmid) noun of entity; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
1- «إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلامَهُمْ», i.e. they cast them and threw them down to draw lots, by way of kināya (metonymy), i.e. a metonymy for the lot.

safi-cedvel:190-191.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (في خلق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (إنّ); (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الأرض) conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to السموات, genitive like it; (الواو) a conjunction; (اختلاف) conjoined to خلق, genitive like it; (الليل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (النهار) conjoined by the wāw to الليل, genitive like it; (اللام) the lām of emphasis; (آيات) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لأولي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آيات, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; (الألباب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause ... has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, naʿt of أولي — or a badal (substitute) from it — «[Note: It may be cut off from qualification and made the khabar of a necessarily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم", or be in the position of an accusative by way of praise.]»; (يذكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (قياما) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative «[Note: If the verb يذكرون is made to include the meaning of يصلّون (they pray), i.e. they stand and sit, then قياما is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar. But if (قياما وقعودا) are plurals of قائم and قاعد, they are ḥāls and nothing else.]»; (قعودا) conjoined by the wāw to (قياما), accusative like it; (الواو) a conjunction; (على جنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the pronoun of يذكرون, and it is conjoined to the first explicit ḥāl, i.e. and lying on their sides, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (يتفكّرون) like يذكرون; (في خلق) like the first, attached to (يتفكّرون); (السموات والأرض) like the first; (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), annexed, with the vocative particle omitted, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) negative; (خلقت) a past verb and its agent; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, direct object; (باطلا) a ḥāl, accusative «[Note: al-Zamakhsharī parsed it as a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its qualifier, i.e. ما خلقت هذا خلقا باطلا (You did not create this in a vain creation) ... or it is by dropping the preposition, either the bāʾ or the lām.]»; (سبحان) a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, its implied form being "نسبح" (we glorify), accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) a conjunction, linking cause and effect «[Note: It may be linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition.]»; (قنا) an imperative verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a direct object, its agent a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta"; (عذاب) a second direct object, accusative; (النار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «يذكرون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يتفكّرون..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The vocative clause «ربنا ...» is in the position of an accusative: the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, and this saying is a ḥāl from the agent in (يذكرون and يتفكرون).
The clause «ما خلقت هذا باطلا» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «سبحانك» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «قنا عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما خلقت «[Note: Or it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if we fall short — or sin — then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.]».

* Morphology:
قياما is either the maṣdar of قام يقوم, of the pattern (bāb) نصر, its wazn being فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, or the plural of قائم, the active participle of قام يقوم, in which the wāw was converted to hamza because it comes after the alif of فاعل; its original is قاوم. In قيام there is a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion (qalb); its original is قواما, and it is a maṣdar or in the form of a maṣdar.
(قعودا) is either a hearsay-based (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb قعد يقعد, of the pattern نصر, its wazn being فعول with two ḍammas, or the plural of قاعد, the active participle of قعد, on the wazn فاعل.
(جنوب) plural of جنب, a noun for the side of a human or other; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): which gathers the three states of man in prayer, namely standing, sitting, and lying on the side or on the back.
2- Mursal (non-metaphorical) trope (al-majāz al-mursal): He mentioned «السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ», meaning the great bodies within them, of marvellous make, fit to be exploited for human benefit; the relation is that of place (maḥalliyya).
3- Concision (al-ījāz): in the saying of the Exalted «وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ».
For under this concision is folded all that science has brought forth of splendid discoveries and marvellous deductions.

* Benefits:
1- Faith between philosophy and the Qur'an.
You will hardly find anything greater or more comprehensive than these verses in the aspects of faith by way of reflection and the Qur'an. The philosophers almost agree that man has innate ideas, supplied by his intellect, for perceiving the truths that rational proofs and logical demonstrations cannot reach. Among these philosophers, the theists, are the early ones such as «Plato and Aristotle» of the Greek philosophers, and the later ones such as Descartes, Kant, Bergson and many others. All of them hold that man is able to rely on his innate ideas to perceive the existence of Allah; he need only look into the dominion of Allah and the perfection and originality that characterise Allah's creatures, from the atom to the galaxy, from the small plant to the great tree, from the grain of sand to the great mountain, and from the drop of water to the great ocean. All that points us, by an innate indication, to the existence of a great Originator behind this origination and invention. al-Ghazālī, al-Fārābī, Ibn Rushd and other philosophers and thinkers of Islam found no escape from resorting to this proof of His existence, the Exalted, alongside the complex and difficult scientific demonstrations. Perhaps all of them drew their guidance from the light of this verse, pausing long before «[Translator's note: the source reads «أما» (as for); «أمام» (before) appears to be meant.]» the saying of the Exalted:
«إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ لَآياتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبابِ» to the end of the verses.

safi-cedvel:81-81.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember); (أخذ) a past verb; (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ميثاق) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (النبيّين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ — and apparently it is with a muḍāf omitted — i.e. the followers of the prophets or the children of the prophets «[Note: This is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān in al-Baḥr, where he said: "So the beginning of the verse agrees with what follows it.. and what makes clear that the covenant was upon the nations is His saying فمن تولّى بعد ذلك فأولئك هم الفاسقون, and this supposition is impossible in the case of the prophets."]», (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (ما) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi whose governor is آتيتكم «[Note: Ibn Kathīr said in his tafsīr: "i.e. whatever I give you of Book and wisdom, and then a messenger comes after it, you shall surely believe in him and surely support him." And (ما) may be a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its ṣila being the clause آتيتكم and the referent pronoun omitted, its implied form being آتيتكم إيّاه; and the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is either His saying من كتاب وحكمة or the clause of an implied oath whose answer is لتؤمننّ به.. and the lām in this case is the lām of oath for an implied oath.. This is the choice of Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī and others.]», (آتيت) a past verb, mabnī on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (من كتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ما) or a tamyīz (specification) of it. (ثمّ) a conjunction; (جاء) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (رسول) fāʿil, nominative; (مصدّق) naʿt (adjective) of رسول, nominative like it; (اللام) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to مصدّق; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) occurring in the answer to an oath; (تؤمننّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn — and it was deleted because of a succession of identical letters — and the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, with no grammatical position; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تؤمننّ); (الواو) conjunction; (لتنصرنّ) like لتؤمننّ.. and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is هو, i.e. Allah; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīr); (أقررتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (أخذتم) like أقررتم; (على) a preposition and (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun of address in His saying أخذتم; and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) a particle for the masculine plural; (إصري) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.. and the yāʾ is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أقررنا) like أقررتم; (قال) like the first; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (اشهدوا) an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) of the ḥāl; (أنا) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (معكم) like the first, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الشاهدين; (من الشاهدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of أنا.
The clause «أخذ الله..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «آتيتكم..» has no grammatical position: explicative of the taking of the covenant.
The clause «جاءكم رسول» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آتيتكم.
The clause «تؤمنن» has no grammatical position: the answer to the oath. The apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath «[Note: Abū Ḥayyān expressed some reservation about this i'rab, saying: "In it — i.e. in this assumed form — there is a very subtle flaw, because what is assumed must be of the same kind as what is overt, and the dependents of this one are the dependents of that one, and this does not hold with the clause جاءكم رسول conjoined to the clause آتيتكم, since it contains no pronoun referring back to the conditional noun.. So if the apodosis here is of a different kind from the answer to the oath, how can the answer to the oath indicate it.." (See al-Baḥr vol. 2 p. 511).]».
The clause «تنصرنّه» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تؤمننّ.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أقررتم» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «أخذتم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أقررتم.
The clause «قالوا..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أقررنا» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اشهدوا» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, joined with the fāʾ, i.e. إن أقررتم فاشهدوا (if you affirm, then bear witness). The implied condition together with its apodosis is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أنا معكم من الشاهدين» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.. or resumptive with no grammatical position.

* Benefits:
1- «لَما آتَيْتُكُمْ»: the early scholars differed over the i'rab of «ما» in several ways, the most important being two. The first: the view of Sībawayh and al-Khalīl that «ما» means «الذي», the implied form of the speech being «الذي آتيتكموه»; the hāʾ, which is the referent pronoun, was deleted to lighten the pronunciation, and al-Akhfash held this view. On this view the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) and «ما» is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
The second: the view of al-Kisāʾī, al-Zajjāj and al-Mubarrad; their view is that «ما» is conditional and the lām is for verification, paving the way for the oath, because taking the covenant is equivalent to making someone swear, and the clause «تؤمننّ» is the answer to the oath, which makes the apodosis of the condition unnecessary.

safi-cedvel:82-82.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تولّى) a past verb, mabnī on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تولّى); (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أولاء) a demonstrative, mabnī on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: It may be parsed as a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is الفاسقون, and the nominal clause هم الفاسقون is the khabar of أولئك.]» to emphasize the quality of the khabar in الفاسقين; (الفاسقون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «من تولّى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تولّى بعد ذلك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «أولئك..» الفاسقون is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
1- فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْفاسِقُونَ: «هم» is a separating pronoun with no grammatical position; the separating pronoun, like «هو وأنا وأنت», stands between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar to signal that what follows it is a khabar and not a naʿt (adjective), and it gives the speech a kind of emphasis of the judgement, for added emphasis.

safi-cedvel:83-83.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (الفاء) conjunction or resumptive; (غير) a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (دين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يبغون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أسلم), which is a past verb; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of من; (الواو) conjunction; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, genitive like it; (طوعا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it is its synonym, for الطوع is synonymous with التسليم; or the verb أسلم has the meaning of "obeyed and submitted".]», (الواو) conjunction; (كرها) maʿṭūf to (طوعا), accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (إليه) like له, attached to (يرجعون), an imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «يبغون» has no grammatical position: resumptive, or conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, the implied form being أيتولّون فغير دين الله يبغون ... (do they turn away, and seek other than the religion of Allah ...).
The clause «أسلم من في السموات» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يرجعون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أسلم.

* Morphology:
(يبغون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by making quiescent and by deletion; its original form is بيغيون: the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and its vowel moved to the ghayn; then the yāʾ was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural, so it became يبغون. «[Translator's note: The source writes «بيغيون»; the intended form is evidently يبغيون.]»
(طوعا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb طاع يطوع, of the نصر class, and طاع يطاع, of the فتح class.. or it is a noun standing for the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the four-letter verb أطاع; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:84-84.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت; (آمنّا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنّا); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, conjoined to the Name of Majesty; (أنزل) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزل); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the first and conjoined to it; (أنزل على) like the first; (إبراهيم) a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, attached to (أنزل); (إسماعيل، إسحاق، يعقوب، الأسباط) nouns conjoined to إبراهيم by conjunctions, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a noun like the first and conjoined to it; (أوتي) like أنزل; (موسى) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (عيسى، النبيّون) two nouns conjoined to موسى, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma and the wāw respectively; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied pronoun in (أوتي), i.e. ما أوتيه موسى ... منزلا من ربّهم (what Mūsā ... was given, sent down from their Lord) «[Note: Or attached to (أوتي).]», and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا) negating; (نفرّق) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (نفرّق); (أحد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد; (الواو) conjunction; (نحن) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (مسلمون), which is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنّا بالله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «أنزل علينا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «أنزل على إبراهيم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «أوتي موسى» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «لا نفرّق» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «نحن له مسلمون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.

* Morphology:
(الأسباط): plural of سبط, a noun for the daughter's son in his relation to his grandfather; but it is used in the verse in the sense of grandchildren, because they are the children of Yaʿqūb, so they are the grandchildren of Ibrāhīm.. The pattern of سبط is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(كدأب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "their custom" (دأبهم) «[Note: Or attached to an implied maṣdar, and there are several views on its implied form: first: they disbelieved with a disbelief like the habit of the people of Pharaoh; second: they were punished with a punishment like the custom of the people of Pharaoh; third: their benefit from wealth and children came to nothing, like the habit of the people of Pharaoh; fourth: they denied with a denial like the custom of the people of Pharaoh (Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī mentioned that).]»; (آل) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote because of being a proper name and foreign; (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to آل فرعون «[Note: Or in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause كذّبوا بآياتنا, and the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause (دأبهم ...).]»; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كذّبوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction, carrying the meaning of causation; (أخذ) a past verb, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بذنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذ), which has been made to include the meaning of "destroyed", and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (شديد) khabar, nominative; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «(دأبهم) كدأب آل فرعون» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا» has no grammatical position; it is explicative of the resumptive clause «[Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption; or it is the khabar if the relative noun (الذين) is parsed as a mubtadaʾ, with the speech being complete at His words آل فرعون; or it is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), with an implied قد, i.e. "denying".]».
The clause «أخذهم الله» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause كذّبوا.
The clause «لله شديد العقاب» [Translator's note: so in the source, for الله شديد العقاب] has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(دأب): maṣdar of دأب يدأب, of the فتح pattern; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ذنوب): plural of ذنب, a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the quadriliteral أذنب; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representative simile (tashbīh tamthīlī): in His words, the Exalted: «إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوالُهُمْ وَلا أَوْلادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئاً، وَأُولئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ النَّارِ، كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ».
The ayah contains the likening of the state of the polytheists — in their striving in their disbelief, their banding together against the Prophet, upon him be peace, and their denial of the signs of Allah that he brought — to the state of the people of Pharaoh in their banding together against Moses, upon him be peace, and their denial of the signs of Allah that he brought. The point of resemblance is composed of a number of things taken together: immersion in disbelief, their enmity toward the Prophet, and denial of the signs of Allah, and not of any single one of these things. So the simile is representative (tamthīlī).

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the agent is "anta" (you); (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قل); (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (السين) a particle of the future; (تغلبون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الواو) conjunction; (تحشرون) like تغلبون; (إلى جهنّم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb تحشرون, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote because of being a proper name and feminine; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (المهاد) fāʿil, nominative; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. Jahannam.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ستغلبون» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تحشرون» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.
The clause «بئس المهاد» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «[Note: Or in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of the omitted one specified for blame, and the nominal clause is resumptive.]».

* Benefits:
1- بئس المهاد:
«ما» may be joined to نعم, as in نعمّا يعظكم به, and it is of three kinds:
a- Single, not followed by anything, as in: دققته دقّا نعمّا ("I pounded it a pounding, how excellent!"); it is a complete definite (maʿrifa tāmma), the agent, and the one specified for praise is omitted, i.e. "excellent is the thing, the pounding".
b- That it be followed by a single word, as in «فنعمّا هي»; in this case it is parsed as the agent, and what follows it is the one specified.
c- That it be followed by a verbal clause, as in «نعمّا يعظكم به» and «بئسما اشتروا به أنفسهم»; then «ما» is parsed as an indefinite in the position of an accusative as tamyīz (specification), and the one specified is omitted, i.e. "excellent as a thing with which He admonishes you is that saying".

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (كان) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; (آية) the postponed noun of كان, nominative; (في فئتين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is a dual; (التقت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and (الألف) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); (فئة) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "one of them" (إحداهما) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause تقاتل; beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is in a context of detailing.]»; (تقاتل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقاتل); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (أخرى) mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: It is permissible for it to be conjoined to the word فئة, so there is no need to imply a khabar, but rather to imply a naʿt.]», the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (كافرة) naʿt of أخرى, nominative like it; and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "fights in the way of the ṭāghūt"; (يرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مثلي) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رأي) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (العين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يؤيّد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (بنصر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤيّد), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (في) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of (إنّ); (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), giving emphasis; (عبرة) the postponed noun of إنّ, accusative; (لأولي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of عبرة, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (الأبصار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «قد كان لكم ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «التقتا» is in the position of a genitive as naʿt of فئتين.
The clause «تقاتل» is in the position of a nominative as naʿt of فئة «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a khabar if (فئة) is parsed as a mubtadaʾ.]».
The clause «يرونهم ...» is in the position of a nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ أخرى «[Note: It is permissible for the clause to be in the position of a nominative as naʿt of أخرى.]».
The clause «الله يؤيّد ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يؤيّد بنصره» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لعبرة» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(التقتا): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of the meeting of two quiescent letters: the alif — the lām of the word — was deleted because it came quiescent before the tāʾ of the feminine; its wazn is افتعتا.
(رأي): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb رأى; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(نصر): an aurally-transmitted maṣdar of the verb نصر; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see ayah 214 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(يشاء): iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its original form is يشيأ, with a yāʾ bearing fatḥa; then its vowel was moved to the shīn and it was made quiescent; then the yāʾ was changed to an alif because it was originally voweled and the letter before it has a fatḥa. (See ayah 247 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(عبرة): a maṣdar of عبر يعبر, of the فتح pattern, or a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb اعتبر; its wazn is فعلة, with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iḥtibāk: it is omission from two corresponding statements, each of which indicates what is omitted from the other. This is in His words: «فِئَةٌ تُقاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَأُخْرى كافِرَةٌ»: each of them is a mubtadaʾ with its khabar omitted, i.e. a believing party fights [Translator's note: the source has تقابل, "faces", evidently a misprint for تقاتل] in the way of Allah, and another, disbelieving party fights in the way of Satan.
2- Double-directed speech (al-kalām al-muwajjah): because a meaning is either understood as one single thing admitting nothing else, or it admits the thing and something other; and that otherness is either an opposite or not. This ayah admits two different meanings, and that otherness is an opposite, since the seeing of the multitude may be attributed to the Muslims or to the polytheists at one and the same time, and there is nothing that gives preference to one over the other, because each of them can validly be applied in the ayah.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(زيّن) a passive past verb; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّن); (حبّ) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الشهوات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (من النساء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشهوات; (البنين، القناطير) two nouns conjoined to النساء by the two conjunctions, the sign of the genitive in البنين being the yāʾ, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (المقنطرة) naʿt (adjective) of القناطير, genitive like it; (من الذهب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of القناطير or of المقنطرة; (الواو) conjunction; (الفضّة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الذهب, genitive like it; (الخيل، الأنعام، الحرث) nouns conjoined to النساء by conjunctions, genitive; (المسوّمة) naʿt of الخيل, genitive like it. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (متاع) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الدنيا) naʿt of الحياة, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عند) an adverb of place — or of time —, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (حسن) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (المآب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «زيّن للناس حبّ ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «ذلك متاع» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «الله عنده حسن ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «عنده حسن المآب» is in the position of a nominative as khabar.

* Morphology:
