1- «فَإِنَّما عَلَيْكَ الْبَلاغُ»: the preposition and its genitive noun were placed before the mubtadaʾ because it is the point of concern on the one hand, and so that the expression may take its musical cadence on the other; both are among the characteristics of eloquence and of the inimitability of the Qur'an.
2- «اهتدوا وتولّوا»: we notice that the weak letter, which is the yāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source], has been deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, which are the weak letter of the verb and the wāw of the plural. Whether the weak verb is past or imperfect, the weak letter is deleted when it meets the wāw of the plural. To distinguish between the wāw which is a weak letter and part of the root of the verb and the wāw which is the wāw of the plural, the grammarians agreed on adding an alif, called the alif of distinction (alif al-tafrīq); an example of that is أحمد يغزو and والمنافقون لم يغزوا. This aspect of writing is one of the pitfalls of spelling, since many confuse the two examples and put the alif of distinction on the verb يغزو and يعلو, contrary to the rule.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الذين) a relative noun, the noun of إنّ, in the position of an accusative; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكفرون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (يقتلون) like يكفرون; (النبيّين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, an emphatic ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of يقتلون; (حقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (يقتلون) like يكفرون; (الذين) like the first, and it is mafʿūl bihi; (يأمرون) like يكفرون; (بالقسط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمرون); (من الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the wāw in the verb يأمرون; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because the relative noun contains the meaning of condition; (بشّر) an imperative verb, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشّرهم); (أليم) naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, genitive like it.
The clause «إنّ الذين يكفرون ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يكفرون بآيات الله» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يقتلون ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يقتلون (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يأمرون ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «بشّرهم» is in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(النبيّين): plural of النبيّ, on the wazn فعيل, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the quadriliteral verb نبّأ, irregularly; the hamza may be lightened so that it becomes a yāʾ — as it came in this ayah — or the hamza may remain as it is, so that it is pronounced النبيء.

* Rhetoric:
1- The dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya): in His words, the Exalted, «فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذابٍ أَلِيمٍ». The use of "good tidings" here is figurative, intended as sarcasm; the meaning is "warn them of a painful punishment", because one is not given good tidings of punishment. So He borrowed "giving good tidings" for warning, after treating opposition as though it were congruity, by way of sarcasm. Therefore the expression with the word بشرهم is more eloquent, because it stings and pains more than the literal word أنذرهم.
2- We often find the fāʾ linking the apodosis coming after the occurrence of a relative noun; in such a case the relative noun may contain the meaning of a conditional noun or bear some connection to it, as in His words, the Exalted: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ ... up to His words فبشرهم; so the fāʾ here links the apodosis.

safi-cedvel:136-136.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (جزاء) second mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (مغفرة) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ جزاء. (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مغفرة, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (جنّات) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مغفرة, nominative like it. (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الأنهار) fāʿil (agent), nominative, (خالدين) ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (جزاؤهم), because it is the object in meaning; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ. (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to خالدين. (الواو) resumptive. (نعم) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise. (أجر) fāʿil of نعم, nominative. (العاملين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being الجنّة (Paradise).
The clause «أولئك جزاؤهم..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جزاؤهم مغفرة» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.
The clause «تجري ...» الأنهار is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «نعم أجرّ العاملين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(العاملين), plural of العامل, an active participle from عمل يعمل, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خلت) a past verb.. and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلت), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (سنن) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (سيروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سيروا), (الفاء) conjunction. (انظروا) like سيروا. (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted khabar (predicate). (كان) a defective past verb. (عاقبة) the ism (subject) of kāna, nominative. (المكذّبين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «خلت سنن..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «سيروا..» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن شككتم فسيروا (if you doubt, then travel).
The clause «انظروا..» is conjoined to the clause سيروا..
The clause «كان عاقبة المكذّبين» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظروا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative (كيف); and this object is restricted by the preposition [Note: i.e. the meaning of the preposition is taken into account in it, because you say: فكّرت فيه (I thought about it), سألت عنه (I asked about it) and نظرت فيه (I looked into it).. (see the i'rab of clauses in al-Mughnī of Ibn Hishām..).].

* Morphology:
(سنن), plural of سنّة, meaning way and custom, from the verb سنّ يسنّ, of the class of نصر. It is a noun on the pattern فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(عاقبة), feminine of عاقب, in the form of an active participle and the meaning of a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. recompense. Its pattern is فاعل, from عقب يعقب, of the class of نصر and the class of ضرب; it is an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb, and there are other maṣdars: عقب with fatḥa then sukūn, and عقوبة with ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The command to travel and look, even though it is specific to the believers, acting according to it is not restricted to one person rather than another; so in it there is also an inducement for the deniers to look at the outcomes of the deniers before them and take heed. This is of the type of majāz (figurative usage), and the relation in this trope is what the matter of travelling in the land leads to.

safi-cedvel:138-138.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (بيان) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بيان [Note: or attached to بيان, since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).], (الواو) conjunction in both places. (هدى، موعظة) both conjoined to بيان, nominative like it, and the sign of the nominative in هدى is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (للمتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدى) or to موعظة, since both are maṣdars.
The clause ... has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بيان) an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb بان يبين, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars: تبيان with fatḥa and with kasra on the tāʾ.

safi-cedvel:139-139.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تهنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو) conjunction. (لا تحزنوا) like لا تهنوا. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الأعلون) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (تم) is a pronoun, the ism (subject) of kāna. (مؤمنين) khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «لا تهنوا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تحزنوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أنتم الأعلون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: فلا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا (then do not weaken and do not grieve) ...

* Morphology:
(تهنوا), in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion. Its origin is توهنوا; the deletion in it followed the course of وجد and وصل in the imperfect. Its pattern is تعلوا.
(الأعلون), in it there is iʿlāl by deletion: the weak letter alif was deleted because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw; then the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa as an indication of the deleted alif. Its pattern is الأفعون with fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (قرح) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (مسّ) a past verb. (القوم) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (قرح) fāʿil, nominative. (مثل) naʿt (adjective) of قرح, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) resumptive. (تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (الأيام) badal (substitute) of تلك, following it in the nominative. (نداول) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن, for majesty, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نداول), (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) causal (li-l-taʿlīl). (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the lām. (الله) fāʿil, nominative. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم الله) is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, attached to (نداولها); and this preposition-phrase is conjoined to an implied preposition-phrase, i.e.: ليتّعظوا وليعلم الله (so that they take admonition, and so that Allah may know) ...
(الواو) conjunction. (يتّخذ) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to the verb يعلم, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يتّخذ) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شهداء - a naʿt placed before what it qualifies -], (شهداء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) parenthetical. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (لا) negative. (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الظالمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يمسسكم قرح» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قد مسّ القوم قرح» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said in al-Baḥr: «The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being فتأسّوا فقد مسّ.. (then take consolation, for [a wound] has touched..), because what is past in meaning cannot be the apodosis of a condition; whoever claims that the apodosis is فقد مسّ.. is inattentive.» End quote. This objection has no justification, because the clause is joined with the fāʾ and the verb is preceded by قد, which brings it close to the present, which is near to the future.].
The clause «تلك الأيام نداولها» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نداولها ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ تلك [Note: Some permit the clause to be a ḥāl, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ being the word الأيام.].
The clause «يعلم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يتّخذ ...» "is in the position [of]" [Translator's note: thus in the source, «في محلّ لها», evidently for «لا محلّ لها», "has no grammatical position"], conjoined to the clause يعلم.
The clause «الله لا يحبّ الظالمين» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «لا يحبّ الظالمين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Morphology:
(قرح), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb قرحته أقرحه, of the class of فرح [Translator's note: thus in the source]; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- وَتِلْكَ الْأَيَّامُ نُداوِلُها بَيْنَ النَّاسِ.
Some permitted parsing «الأيام» as the khabar of the demonstrative «تلك», which is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. The error in this direction is clear, because a noun made definite by «ال» after a demonstrative is parsed only as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) or badal. On that Ibn Mālik says:
وكل اسم معرّف بأل ... بعد اسم إشارة فعطف أو بدل
(Every noun made definite by al- ... after a demonstrative is an apposition or a substitute.)
In this verse, parsing الأيام as a badal is the clear and correct view, and in it the meaning flows and is clear.

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (ليمحّص ... آمنوا) like ليعلم الله الذين آمنوا in the previous verse.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يمحص الله) is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what ليعلم in the previous verse is attached to, for it is conjoined to it.
(الواو) conjunction. (يمحق) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to يمحّص, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الكافرين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يمحّص الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يمحق ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يمحّص.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (لمّا): an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال). (أحسّ): past verb. (عيسى): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif. (من): preposition, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الكفر), which is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (قال): like أحسّ, and the fāʿil is "هو". (من): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أنصار): khabar (predicate), nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the rāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (إلى الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the first-person pronoun in أنصاري, i.e. "taking refuge in Allah". (قال): like أحسّ. (الحواريّون): fāʿil, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (نحن): a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (أنصار): khabar, nominative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (آمنّا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (بالله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنّا). (الواو): conjunction. (اشهد): imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الباء): preposition. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ. (مسلمون): khabar, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا مسلمون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (اشهد).
The clause «أحسّ عيسى..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «من أنصاري..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قال الحواريّون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «نحن أنصار الله» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «آمنّا بالله» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from أنصار «[Note: That is with قد implied; it may also be in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the pronoun نحن.]».
The clause «اشهد» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause نحن أنصار.

* Morphology:
(أنصار): plural of نصير, on the measure of شريف; it is a derived adjective, an intensive form of the active participle, from the transitive نصر ينصر, of the نصر class.
(الحواريّون): plural of الحواريّ; the final yāʾ is for relation (nisba). The word is derived from الحور, which is whiteness, for the disciples used to bleach clothes. It has been said it is from حار يحور, i.e. to return, as though they were those returning to Allah; and it has been said it is derived from the whiteness of the face and heart, and their clarity and purity.

* Rhetoric:
- «فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسى مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ»: the basic sense of الإحساس is perception by one of the five outward senses; it has been borrowed by a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya) for knowledge without doubt. It has been said: it is a majāz mursal (metonymic trope) for that, of the type of mentioning the antecedent and intending the consequent. The motive for that is that unbelief is not something that is perceived by the senses.

* Benefits:
- The temporal لما (lammā al-ḥīniyya): it is the adverbial one; it is specific to the past, and its apodosis is a past verb, e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ», or a nominal clause joined with «the إذا of surprise», e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ», or with the fāʾ, e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ». Its apodosis may be omitted.
Sībawayh said: the most wondrous of words is «لما»: if it enters upon the past it is an adverb, if it enters upon the imperfect it is a particle, and otherwise it means «إلّا».

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا): a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf) from which the vocative particle has been omitted.. and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (آمنّا): past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (الباء): preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنا). (أنزلت): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (التاء) is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (اتّبعنا): like آمنّا. (الرسول): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition. (اكتبنا): imperative verb..
(نا) is an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (مع): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (اكتبنا). (الشاهدين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The vocative clause «ربّنا» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, imploring mercy.
The clause «آمنّا» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from the clause آمنّا in the previous verse, taking its grammatical position.
The clause «أنزلت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «اتّبعنا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنّا بما أنزلت.
The clause «اكتبنا» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if our saying is true, then write us down"..

* Morphology:
(الشاهدين): plural of الشاهد, active participle from شهد يشهد, of the فرح class; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (مكروا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو): resumptive. (مكر): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (خير): khabar (predicate), nominative. (الماكرين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The three clauses: have no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الماكرين): plural of الماكر, active participle from مكر يمكر, of the نصر class; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of mushākala (verbal correspondence), which is mentioning a thing with the word for something else because it occurs in its company. Mushākala has occurred in His saying, the Exalted, وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ. Scheming, inasmuch as it is basically a stratagem by which one draws another into harm, cannot be attributed to Him, glory be to Him, except by way of mushākala.

* Benefits:
1- «وَمَكَرُوا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ»: this is the mushākala to which we drew attention earlier. Let the reader know that Allah does not scheme; rather the style runs in correspondence with the style the unbelievers adopted.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ): an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". (قال): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (يا): vocative particle. (عيسى): a vocative of a single proper name (munādā mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif, in the position of accusative. (انّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الياء): a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (متوفّي): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (رافعك): like متوفّيك, by conjunction to it. (إلى): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رافع. (الواو): conjunction. (مطهّرك): like متوفّيك, by conjunction to it. (من): preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to مطهّر. (كفروا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction «[Note: The wāw may be resumptive, with the address directed to the Prophet ﷺ, and (جاعل) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "أنا"; on this view the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.]». (جاعل): conjoined to متوفّيك, nominative like it. (الذين): in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (اتّبعوا): like كفروا, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (فوق): adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of جاعل. (الذين): like the previous. (كفروا): like the first. (إلى يوم): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاعل. (ثمّ): conjunction. (إليّ): like the first, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (مرجع): postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (أحكم): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (بين): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أحكم), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في): preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أحكم). (كنتم): an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna, in the position of nominative. (في): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تختلفون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال الله ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يا عيسى» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّي متوفّيك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «كفروا (the first)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause «اتّبعوك» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «كفروا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative (الذين).
The clause «إليّ مرجعكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إنّي متوفّيك.
The clause «أحكم بينكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إليّ مرجعكم.
The clause «كنتم..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تختلفون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(متوفّي): active participle from توفّاه الله; its pattern is متفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(رافع): active participle from رفع; its pattern is فاعل.
(مطهّر): active participle from the quadriliteral طهّر; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(مرجع): a noun of place or time from رجع on the pattern مفعل with kasra on the ʿayn, because its ʿayn in the imperfect has kasra, so it is of the ضرب class. The word may also properly be a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رجع, used in that sense in the verse.

* Rhetoric:
1- Ibn Abī Ḥātim reported from Qatāda, who said: This is a case of what is placed earlier and what is placed later, i.e. "raising you to Me and taking you in death". This is one of the interpretations required by the apparent sense of the verse conflicting with what is well known and stated explicitly in the verse.
The second of them: that what is meant is "fulfilling your term and causing you to die a natural death; I will not give power over you to anyone who would kill you", so the speech is a kināya (metonymy) for his protection from enemies.
The third of them: that what is meant by death here is sleep, because the two are brothers, and each of them is applied to the other.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), conjunction. (أمّا): a particle of condition and detailing. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كفروا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (أعذّب): imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا", and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (عذابا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb). (شديدا): naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا), accusative like it. (في الدنيا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اعذّب); the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (الآخرة): conjoined to الدنيا, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating, inoperative. (اللام): preposition, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (ناصرين): genitive in form, nominative in position, as postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «الذين كفروا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أحكم in the previous [verse].
The clause «أعذّبهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ما لهم من ناصرين» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أعذّبهم.

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (أمّا الذين آمنوا): like أمّا الذين كفروا in the previous verse. (الواو): conjunction. (عملوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الصالحات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (يوفّي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (أجور): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (لا): negating. (يحبّ): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الظالمين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «الذين آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الذين كفروا in the previous verse.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يوفّيهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «الله لا يحبّ..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يحبّ الظالمين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Benefits:
1- أمّا: it is a particle that always carries the sense of condition and emphasis, and usually that of detailing. The first is shown by the necessity of the fāʾ after it, e.g. «فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ. وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَقُولُونَ ماذا أَرادَ اللَّهُ بِهذا مَثَلًا».
The second is shown by the fact that when you intend to emphasise «زيد ذاهب» (Zayd is going) you say: أمّا زيد فذاهب, i.e. he is going without doubt. Detailing is shown by surveying its occurrences, e.g. «أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكانَتْ لِمَساكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ، وَأَمَّا الْغُلامُ.. وَأَمَّا الْجِدارُ», and likewise «فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلا تَقْهَرْ وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلا تَنْهَرْ».

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "الأمر كذلك", and the clause نتلوه is a ḥāl (circumstantial).]»; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (نتلو): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (على): preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوه). (من الآيات): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in (نتلوه) «[Note: Or attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, the clause نتلوه being a ḥāl.]». (الذكر): conjoined by the wāw to الآيات, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الحكيم): naʿt (adjective) of الذكر, genitive like it.
The clause «ذلك نتلوه» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «نتلوه» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).

* Morphology:
(الذكر): maṣdar (verbal noun) of ذكر يذكر, of the نصر class; but it is used here as a primitive (jāmid) noun, since it means the Noble Qur'an.
(الحكيم): a derived adjective; its pattern is فعيل with the meaning of the passive, i.e. المحكم (with fatḥa on the kāf) (see al-Baqara 32).

safi-cedvel:59-59.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (مثل): the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (عيسى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra. (عند): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from مثل. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (كمثل): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ. (آدم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign. (خلق): past verb; (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من تراب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلق). (ثمّ): conjunction. (قال): like خلق. (اللام): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قال). (كن فيكون): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (118) of Sūrat al-Baqara and in verse (47) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إنّ مثل عيسى..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلقه..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from آدم, with قد implied. Abū Ḥayyān, moreover, made it an explanation of the meaning of "مثل آدم".]».
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause خلقه.
The clause «كن» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause يقول «[Translator's note: so in the text, apparently carried over from verse 47; the verb in this verse is قال.]».

* Benefits:
- «إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ»:
This verse was revealed in the ninth year of the Hijra, «the Year of Delegations». The delegation of Najrān came to him; he offered them Islam but they did not accept it, and they asked him his view of the Messiah, so Allah revealed this verse to him. When they disputed with the Messenger and argued with him at length, he called them to «mutual imprecation (al-mulāʿana)». They consulted among themselves, and Allah cast terror into their hearts, so they dreaded the consequence of the imprecation and asked the Messenger of Allah to excuse them from it. Then they proposed to the Messenger ﷺ that he send with them a trustworthy man to judge between them in what they disagreed about. «فأشر أبت» «[Translator's note: so printed; evidently فاشرأبّت "craned/longed"]» the soul of ʿUmar to be the trustworthy one, but the Messenger ﷺ called Abū ʿUbayda and sent him with the people to judge between them; and from then on Abū ʿUbayda became the trustworthy one (amīn) of this Umma, may Allah be pleased with them all.

safi-cedvel:172-172.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is "they" (هم) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause «للذين أحسنوا منهم أجر....», and it is permissible for it to be a naʿt (adjective) of المؤمنين in the previous verse.]»; (استجابوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) a preposition and its genitive noun «[Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is لله.]», attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استجابوا); (الواو) conjunction; (الرسول) conjoined to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استجابوا); (ما) a maṣdar particle; (أصاب) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (القرح) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أصابهم القرح) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (أحسنوا) like استجابوا; (من) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (أحسنوا); (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (أجر) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt of أجر, nominative like it.
The clause «استجابوا لله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أصابهم القرح» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (ما).
The clause «أحسنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أحسنوا.
The nominal clause «للذين أحسنوا.. أجر» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Benefits:
1- The wise commander.
Scarcely had the dawn of the second day after the battle of Uḥud broken when the caller of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ summoned the believers to prepare to set out in pursuit of the polytheists, and he restricted this to those who had been present at the battle the day before. The Messenger of Allah went out with the army until he reached Ḥamrāʾ al-Asad, eight miles from Medina in the direction of Mecca, and stayed there three days, challenging the army of the polytheists. As for the disbelievers, Allah cast terror into their hearts, and they thought that reinforcements had come to the Muslims, so they did not stop for anything until they reached Mecca. One result of that was that the Messenger of Allah established the awe of the Muslims in the hearts of their enemies, among the Bedouin and the polytheists outside Medina and among the Jews and the hypocrites inside it, and raised the morale of the believers; they returned from this expedition unharmed, since none of the polytheists confronted them.

safi-cedvel:173-173.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is "I praise" (أمدح) «[Note: Some permitted it to be a badal (substitute) from الذين استجابوا, but those are other than these:
those who responded are the people of Uḥud, while those to whom the people said it are some of the believers or all of them.]»; (قال) a past verb; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (الناس) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الناس) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (جمعوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (لكم) like لهم, attached to (جمعوا); (الفاء) conjunction, linking the cause to the effect; (اخشوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الفاء) conjunction; (زاد) like قال, and (هم) mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), referring to the warning understood from the context of the verse; (إيمانا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (قالوا) like جمعوا; (حسب) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of genitive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. Allah's help; (الواو) conjunction - or resumptive -; (نعم) an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; (الوكيل) fāʿil, nominative; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah".
The clause «قال لهم الناس» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الناس قد جمعوا..» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «جمعوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «اخشوهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause جمعوا «[Note: Conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one is permissible here because of the causal link.]».
The clause «زادهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause قال ...
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause زادهم ...
The clause «حسبنا الله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «نعم الوكيل» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause حسبنا الله ... or has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الوكيل): a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from وكل يكل, of the ḍaraba class (bāb ḍaraba); its pattern is فعيل.
(حسبنا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) with the meaning of an active participle, i.e. محسبنا - with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the sīn - i.e. "sufficing us". The pattern of حسب is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn (and see verse 206 of Sūrat al-Baqara).

* Rhetoric:
- General and particular (al-ʿumūm wa-l-khuṣūṣ): in mentioning "the people" in general after mentioning the particular ones, namely Abū Sufyān and those with him; this is a case of using the general and intending the particular.

safi-cedvel:174-174.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (انقلبوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in انقلبوا; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نعمة; (الواو) conjunction; (فضل) conjoined to نعمة, genitive like it; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and jussivization; (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (سوء) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) conjunction; (اتّبعوا) like انقلبوا; (رضوان) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (ذو) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; (فضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عظيم) a naʿt of فضل, genitive like it.
The clause «انقلبوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا in the previous verse.
The clause «لم يمسسهم سوء» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «اتّبعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause انقلبوا.
The clause «الله ذو فضل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- Ordered lapping and unfolding (al-laff wa-l-nashr al-murattab): in His saying «بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ», with the mention of what is lapped and unfolded left implicit, namely: bodily safety, which goes back to "blessing", and profit from trade, which goes back to "bounty".

safi-cedvel:175-175.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) a restraining particle and the particle restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance, (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) a particle for the masculine plural; (الشيطان) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, with the clause يخوّف as the khabar ... or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يخوّف, and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.]»; (يخوف) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو) ... and the first object is implied, i.e. "he makes you fear" (يخوّفكم); (أولياء) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā; (تخافوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (خافوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (النون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (كنتم) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) is the noun of kāna; (مؤمنين) khabar, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «ذلك الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يخوّف أولياءه» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشيطان «[Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «لا تخافوهم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition «[Note: i.e.: if they urge you to disobedience, then do not fear them ... or: if you are believers, then do not fear them.]».
The clause «خافون» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or explicative ... and the apodosis of the stated condition is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: if you are believers, then fear Me.

safi-cedvel:97-97.t:
* I'rab:
(في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (آيات) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (بينات) naʿt (adjective) of آيات, nominative like it; (مقام) a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of آيات, nominative (marfūʿ) like it «[Note: It may be a postponed mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. منها مقام ... (among them is the Station ...), and the clause is either a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات or a naʿt of it. It may also be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هي.]», and the linking pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e. منها; (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, being a diptote; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (دخل) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (كان) an incomplete past verb in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (آمنا) khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «فيه آيات ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the relative noun in the previous verse «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position: resumptive.]».
The clause «من دخله كان ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «دخله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «كان آمنا» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (على الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; (حجّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (البيت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a badal (substitute) of part from whole, the whole being الناس; a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, and the linking pronoun is implied, i.e. استطاع منهم (whoever of them is able) «[Note: (من) cannot be the fāʿil of the maṣdar حج, because that would corrupt the meaning.]», (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of (سبيلا) — a naʿt that preceded what it qualifies; (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (من كفر) like من دخل; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) ism of إنّ, accusative; (غنيّ) khabar, nominative; (عن العالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غنيّ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «لله على الناس حجّ» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «استطاع» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «من كفر ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».. «[Translator's note: As in the parallel «دخله» above, the clause meant as the khabar is evidently «كفر».]»
The clause «إنّ الله غنيّ ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ, or it is a causal explanation of the omitted apodosis, i.e. فالله مستغن عنه إنّ الله غنيّ عن العالمين (Allah has no need of him; indeed Allah is free of need of the worlds).

* Benefits:
The words of Allah the Exalted: «وَمَنْ دَخَلَهُ كانَ آمِناً».
The grammarians mentioned meanings indicated by the sisters of كان, namely: (a) - what indicates timing:
1- أصبح, for morning timing, e.g. (أصبح الطير منتشرا في الحقل) (the birds were, in the morning, spread over the field).
2- أضحى — for forenoon timing — e.g. (أضحى الجوّ صحوا) (the weather became clear in the forenoon). 3- أمسى — for evening timing: e.g. (أمسى الفلاح عائدا إلى بيته) (in the evening the farmer was returning to his house).
(b) what indicates transformation, such as صار, e.g. (صار البرتقال عصيرا) (the oranges became juice).
(c) what indicates negation, such as ليس, e.g. (ليس الشجر مثمرا) (the trees are not bearing fruit).
(d) - what indicates continuation, such as (ما زال- ما برح- ما فتى- ما انفك), e.g. (ما زال القمر منيرا) (the moon is still shining). (e) what indicates the statement of duration, namely (ما دام), e.g. (ينجح الطالب ما دام مجدا) (the student succeeds as long as he is diligent), i.e. (for the duration of his remaining diligent).

safi-cedvel:176-176.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā; (يحزن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (يسارعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (في الكفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of يسارعون «[Note: Or it is attached to the verb يسارعون, by making it imply the meaning "they fall into it" (يقعون فيه).]»; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) a pronoun, the noun of inna, in the position of accusative; (لن) a particle of negation, the accusative and futurity; (يضرّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (شيئا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is part of it. (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative; (لا) negative; (يجعل) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يجعل); (حظا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (حظّا); (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) like the first one, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألا يجعل ...) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being يريد.
The clause «لا يحزنك الذين..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يسارعون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّهم لن يضرّوا ...» has no grammatical position, giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لن يضرّوا..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يريد الله ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption or parenthetical.
The clause «لا يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لن يضرّوا ...

* Morphology:
(حظّا): the noun meaning "share" (نصيب), of the verb حظّ يحظّ, of the fataḥa class (bāb fataḥa); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn. It is pluralised as حظوظ, with a ḍamma on the ḥāʾ, حظاظ, with a kasra on the ḥāʾ, and أحظّ, with a fatḥa on the hamza, a ḍamma on the ḥāʾ and a doubled ẓāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- «إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئاً»: the indefiniteness in His saying «شيئا» is to emphasise the paltriness, contemptibility and insignificance in it.

* Benefits:
1- «يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا»: «ألّا» is composed of two words assimilated into each other, namely the accusative-governing أن and the negative لا. When «لا» comes after the accusative-governing أن, as in this example, «لا» does not prevent «أن» from governing, and it remains putting the imperfect verb in the accusative. We know that «أن» is a particle of the maṣdar, the accusative and futurity; and this last property, «futurity», is not exclusive to «أن», but all the accusative-governing particles carry this property, for all of them shift the meaning of the imperfect verb from the present to the future. «أن» does not occur after a verb meaning certainty and firm knowledge; if it does occur there, it is lightened from «أنّ», as in «أفلا يرون أن لا يرجع إليهم قولا».
But if it occurs after what indicates supposition or doubt, it may be made operative or inoperative, and the accusative is preferable. Know that «the أن that puts the imperfect in the accusative is used only in a context of hope and desire, and after what does not indicate certainty or supposition».

safi-cedvel:98-98.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is أنت; (يا) a vocative particle; (أهل) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (اللام) a preposition and (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تكفرون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تكفرون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial) — or resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (شهيد) khabar (predicate), nominative; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to شهيد; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا أهل الكتاب» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «تكفرون» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «الله شهيد» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:99-99.t:
* I'rab:
(قل يا أهل ... سبيل الله) the i'rab of its counterpart was given in the previous verse, in single words and clauses.. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (آمن) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (تبغون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (عوجا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: It was said: البغي here is transgression, i.e. they transgress against it or in it ... and al-Zajjāj and al-Ṭabarī said: يبغون means "they seek for it crookedness".. so on this view (عوجا) is a mafʿūl bihi.]», (الواو) of the ḥāl; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شهداء) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, operating like ليس; (الله) the Name of Majesty, ism of ما, nominative; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (غافل) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما; (عن) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by a description, the clause being its description ... It may also be maṣdariyya, with the interpreted maṣdar in the position of genitive.]», mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) غافل; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «آمن» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «تبغونها ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تصدون or of السبيل, or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنتم شهداء» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تبغون.
The clause «ما الله بغافل ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause «[Note: Or resumptive with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(عوجا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb عاج يعوج, of the نصع class «[Translator's note: The source writes «نصع»; evidently نصر is meant.]»; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn. The maṣdar may come with fatḥa on the first radical, but the Arabs distinguished between them, assigning the form with kasra on the first radical to abstract meanings and the form with fatḥa to concrete things.. You say: in his religion and his speech there is عوج, with kasra, and in the wall there is عوج, with fatḥa.

* Benefits:
1- The words of Allah the Exalted: «وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ».
This is the Hijazi negating «ما». It operates like ليس only in the dialect of the people of the Hijaz, in whose dialect the Noble Qur'an came, and in the dialect of the people of Tihāma and Najd; that is why it is called «the Hijazi negating ما». In the dialect of Tamīm, however, it is inoperative, and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ and khabar.
And «the Hijazi ما» operates like ليس only under four conditions:
a- that its khabar does not precede its ism.
b- that what its khabar governs does not precede its ism.
c- that «إن» is not added after it.
d- that its negation is not cancelled by «إلا».
If any one of these conditions is missing, its operation is void, as in the words of Allah the Exalted: وَما أَمْرُنا إِلَّا واحِدَةٌ.

safi-cedvel:100-100.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and (ها) for alerting; (الذين) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of accusative — following the position — as a badal (substitute) of أيّ or a naʿt (adjective) of it; (آمنوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إن) a conditional particle making the verb jussive; (تطيعوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (فريقا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of (فريقا); (أوتوا) a past verb, passive, mabnī on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (يردّوا) like تطيعوا, and it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يردّوكم) «[Note: Or attached to كافرين.]», (إيمان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (كافرين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ «[Note: Or it is a second mafʿūl bihi of the verb ردّ, if it is among the verbs of transformation.]».
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ان تطيعوا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «يردّوكم» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a condition, not joined with the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:142-142.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) أم meaning بل (rather). (حسبتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تدخلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الجنّة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تدخلوا ...) is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi of the verb حسب [Note: or it stands in place of the two objects of حسب - according to the view of Sībawayh. -]. As for the second object, it is omitted, and the implied form is: حسبتم دخولكم الجنّة حاصلا (you thought your entering Paradise to be a settled matter).
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لمّا) a particle of negation, of the jussive and of converting [the imperfect to past meaning]. (يعلم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (جاهدوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil. (الواو) the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya). (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the wāw of accompaniment [Note: Shudhūr al-Dhahab of Ibn Hishām ... Some explained the fatḥa by saying that the verb is jussive - not accusative - conjoined to the first يعلم, and was given a fatḥa because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, since the fatḥa is the lightest of the vowels.], and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الصابرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the speech before it, i.e. ... and there is not yet knowledge of who strove and knowledge of who was patient.
The clause «حسبتم..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تدخلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يعلم الله ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, i.e.: did you think that you would enter Paradise while your state is this state? [Note: See Shudhūr al-Dhahab of Ibn Hishām, p. 375, third edition.].
The clause «جاهدوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يعلم الصابرين» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:143-143.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and تم is a pronoun, the ism (subject) of kāna. (تمنّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) - one of the two tāʾs has been deleted from it - and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الموت) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تمنّون), (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تلقوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تلقوه) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الفاء) conjunction. (قد) like the first. (رأيتم) a past verb and its fāʿil - the seeing is either visual or mental - [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said: His saying تنظرون after His saying رأيتموه [indicates] that the seeing here is mental, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being حاضرا (present). Visual seeing of death is by seeing its effects, and the verb then takes one object.], and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), from the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the ḍamma of the mīm, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) [Note: If the meaning is: you are looking into your deed now after the end of the battle, then the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumed.], (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (تنظرون) like تمنّون.
The clause كنتم تمنّون ... has no grammatical position, being the answer of an implied oath ... and the oath is conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تمنّون الموت» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of كنتم.
The clause «تلقوه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «رأيتموه» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كنتم تمنّون.
The clause «أنتم تنظرون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تنظرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.

* Morphology:
(تمنّون), in it one of the two tāʾs is deleted for lightness; its origin is تتمنّون. In it there is also iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its lām (third radical), which is the alif, was deleted from it because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw of the plural, and the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa as an indication of the alif.
Its pattern is تفعّون.
(تلقوه), in it there is iʿlāl by deletion, following the course of (تمنّون) (see verse 37 of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān).

safi-cedvel:144-144.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative, inoperative (muhmala). (محمّد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (إلّا) a particle of restriction. (رسول) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خلت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif which was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلت), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الرسل) fāʿil (agent), nominative. (الهمزة) for interrogation of denial (istifhām inkārī). (الفاء) conjunction. (إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (مات) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (أو) a conjunction. (قتل) a past verb, passive, in the position of the jussive, conjoined to مات, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (انقلب) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil. (على أعقاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انقلبتم), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction - or resumptive -. (من) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (ينقلب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (على عقبي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينقلب), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis. (لن) a particle of negation and of the accusative. (يضرّ) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. he will not harm Him with any harm at all. (الواو) resumptive. (السين) a particle of the future. (يجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الشاكرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ما محمّد إلّا رسول» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «خلت ... الرسل» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt (adjective) of رسول.
The clause «إن مات ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «قتل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to مات.
The clause «انقلبتم..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من ينقلب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause - or resumptive.
The clause «ينقلب ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «لن يضرّ الله» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سيجزي الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(محمّد), a proper name derived from الحمد (praise), on the form of the passive participle of the quadriliteral (حمّد); its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying, the Exalted, «وَما مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ» is the art of qaṣr (restriction). Linguistically it means confinement, and technically it is the specifying of one of two matters over the other and negating it of everything else. It occurs as restriction of the qualified to the quality and the reverse; the verse is of the first type, i.e. others like him have passed away before him, so he will pass away as they passed away. The restriction is reversing (qalbī), for when they turned back on their heels it was as though they believed that he, upon him be blessings and peace, was a messenger not like the other messengers in that he would pass away as they passed away, and that it was obligatory to hold fast to his religion after him just as it was obligatory to hold fast to their religion after them. So He refuted them by saying that he is nothing but a messenger like the other messengers, so he will pass away as they passed away, and it is obligatory to hold fast to his religion just as it is obligatory to hold fast to theirs. It was also said that it is a restriction of singling (qaṣr ifrād), for when they found it momentous that he, upon him be blessings and peace, would not remain with them, they were treated as those who deem his perishing far-fetched, as if they believed two attributes of him: messengership and remoteness from perishing. So He refuted them by saying that he is restricted to messengership and does not go beyond it to remoteness from perishing.

safi-cedvel:145-145.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative. (كان) a defective past verb. (لنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تموت) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تموت) is in the position of the nominative as the ism (subject) of kāna.
(الّا) a particle of restriction. (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of تموت [Note: i.e. it dies with its term ending by the permission of Allah.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (كتابا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being كتب ذلك (He has decreed that). (مؤجلا) naʿt (adjective), accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (من) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يرد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (ثواب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الدنيا) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (نؤت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن, for majesty. (من) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نؤته). (الواو) conjunction. (من يرد ... نؤته منها) like the preceding. (الواو) conjunction. (السين) a particle of the future. (نجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is نحن, for majesty. (الشاكرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ما كان لنفس أن تموت» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تموت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «من يرد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يرد ثواب ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «نؤته منها» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من يرد (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يرد (the first).
The clause «يرد ثواب (the second)» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (من) «2».
The clause «نؤته (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سنجزي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(كتابا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun); its verb is كتب يكتب, of the class of نصر, meaning to prescribe and decree; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(مؤجلا), a passive participle from the quadriliteral verb أجّل; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(ثواب), a noun of maṣdar from the quadriliteral verbs أثاب or ثوّب; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; or it is a noun for that with which one is rewarded.
(يرد), in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is يريد. The yāʾ is converted from a wāw, because its bare form is راد يرود. Its imperfect in the quadriliteral was originally يرود with sukūn on the rāʾ and kasra on the wāw; the vowel on the wāw was felt heavy and transferred to the rāʾ; the letter before the wāw became kasra-voweled, so the wāw was converted to yāʾ, and it was said يريد.. The pattern of يرد is يفل with ḍamma on the yāʾ of the imperfect.
(نؤته), in it the hamza is deleted from its beginning for lightness, following the course of ننفق; its origin is نؤأته, just as [the origin of ننفق] was نؤنفق. In it there is also iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is نؤتيه. Its pattern is نفعه with ḍamma on the nūn and kasra on the ʿayn (al-Baqara - 247).

safi-cedvel:146-146.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (كأيّ) a noun of allusion (kināya) to a number, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (من نبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, tamyīz (specification). (قاتل) a past verb. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قاتل), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ربّيّون) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw [Note: The fāʿil of قاتل may be a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring back to نبيّ; in that case (ربّيّون) is a postponed mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is the adverb معه, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil pronoun in قاتل.], (كثير) naʿt (adjective) of (ربّيّون), nominative like it [Note: (كثير) remained singular because it is an adjective on the pattern فعيل, in which singular and plural are the same.], (الفاء) conjunction. (ما) negative. (وهنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.
And the wāw is the fāʿil. (اللام) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (وهنوا) [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of the genitive, and the clause after it a naʿt of it.], (أصاب) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أصابهم) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (أصابهم), i.e. it befell them while striving in the way of Allah.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (ما ضعفوا) like ما وهنوا. (الواو) conjunction. (ما استكانوا) like ما وهنوا. (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الصابرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «كأيّ من نبيّ قاتل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
